crossRefs.note: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son…

translations.web: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
translations.bsb: For through wisdom your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.
translations.kjv: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
translations.asv: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, And the years of thy life shall be increased.
